posts.title: Mobile carriers can get your GPS location
posts.description: In iOS 26.3, Apple introduced a new privacy feature which limits “precise location” data made available to cellular networks via cell towers. The feature is only available to devices with Apple’s in-house modem introduced in 2025. The announcement1 says https://support.apple.com/en-us/126101 ↩

posts.title: CAA Footgun
posts.description: CAA is a DNS record type which specifies the Certificate Authorities who are allowed to issue certificates for a domain.
